diagnostic_tail: Dopamine cluster publisher error: Dopamine cluster draft rejected: The article gives an incomplete and therefore misleading A12/A13 compatibility range. The supplied facts state that A12 and A13 are listed for iOS 15.0–18.7.1 and separately for iOS 26.0–26.0.1, but the article repeatedly presents iOS 15.0–18.7.1 as the full A12/A13 range and never mentions the documented iOS 26 range.; The article claims to explain the current 3.x compatibility ranges while omitting the supplied A12/A13 iOS 26.0–26.0.1 entry. The compatibility section and FAQ should explicitly preserve both disjoint ranges rather than implying one continuous endpoint.; The social post is visibly truncated, ending with “instead of relying on a no,” so it is unfinished editorial text.
